    """Get all 4-connected regions of a single color"""

                component = []

                visited[r, c] = True

# Get 4-connected components for each main color
def get_4_connected_components(grid, target_color):
    height, width = grid.shape
    visited = np.zeros((height, width), dtype=bool)
    components = []
    
    for r in range(height):
        for c in range(width):
            if grid[r, c] == target_color and not visited[r, c]:
                component = []
                queue = [(r, c)]
                visited[r, c] = True
                
                idx = 0
                while idx < len(queue):
                    curr_r, curr_c = queue[idx]
                    idx += 1
                    component.append((curr_r, curr_c))
                    
                    # Check 4 neighbors only (no diagonals)
                    for dr, dc in [(-1,0), (1,0), (0,-1), (0,1)]:
                        nr, nc = curr_r + dr, curr_c + dc
                        if 0 <= nr < height and 0 <= nc < width:
                            if grid[nr, nc] == target_color and not visited[nr, nc]:
